name: 再现天涯（08年修改版本）
english_description: The 2008 revised re-release of the same 'Tianya Reborn' game as this collection's zxty — the master.lpc content differs with no exact hash match, but it shares the same title and origin. Its quit command has a genuine anti-abuse mechanism: a new account logged in for under 30 minutes must press quit twice to actually exit without saving, a deliberate design choice rather than a bug.
